heading.purpose: Page titles, section titles, card titles. Weight (700-800) carries hierarchy, not size.

label.purpose: Uppercase, wide-tracked labels: nav items, eyebrows, filter pills. Never for body copy.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid teal call-to-action. One per screen, reserved for the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 0.75rem; background-color: #2D8C8C; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #2D8C8C; font-family: Manrope, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(45,140,140,0.24); transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #1F6868; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #F3EFE7, 0 0 0 4px #2D8C8C; }

components.name: Soft Button
components.description: Tinted secondary-emphasis button, for actions that shouldn't compete with the primary button on the same screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-soft { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 0.75rem; background-color: rgba(45,140,140,0.1); color: #1F6868; border: 1px solid rgba(45,140,140,0.35); font-family: Manrope, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-soft:hover { background-color: rgba(45,140,140,0.16); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-soft:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #F3EFE7, 0 0 0 4px #2D8C8C; }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Rounded status/filter chip with idle and active states, plus a nested count pill.
components.html: Overdue 4Today 2
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 24px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: Manrope, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-pill-idle { border: 1px solid rgba(200,190,173,0.4); background-color: transparent; color: rgba(78,81,75,0.8); } .ds-pill-idle:hover { background-color: rgba(30,30,27,0.05); color: #1E1E1B; } .ds-pill-active { border: 1px solid rgba(45,140,140,0.25); background-color: rgba(45,140,140,0.05); color: #2D8C8C; } .ds-pill-count { border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 4px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-pill-count-idle { background-color: rgba(111,115,106,0.15); color: rgba(111,115,106,0.7); } .ds-pill-count-active { background-color: rgba(45,140,140,0.1); color: #2D8C8C; }

narrative.overview:
ACTSIX looks like a well-kept workroom behind a sanctuary: warm parchment surfaces, one confident accent, and tools put back exactly where they belong. Nothing performs for its own sake — the interface exists to get administrative weight off a leader's shoulders so attention returns to people and the Word. Density stays moderate: enough information to act on at a glance, never a wall of chrome. Warmth comes from parchment neutrals and soft teal, not from saturation or decoration; restraint is the brand.

The system explicitly rejects two extremes: cold enterprise-admin density (Salesforce/SAP/Jira greys-and-grids) and consumer-app flash (gradients, loud motion, competing accent colors). Every screen should pass the "Thursday-afternoon test" — calmer, not busier, for someone juggling three ministry responsibilities at once.
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment neutrals as the base, not white-and-grey
One accent color (teal) carries all primary meaning; everything else is neutral or semantic
Soft, whisper-level shadows — structural hints, never decoration
Generous, consistent radii (control: 12px, panel: 16px) — nothing sharp-cornered
Heavy-weight (800) heading type against a calm, regular-weight body — hierarchy through weight, not size alone
Motion is small and quiet: 1px hover lifts, 120–160ms transitions, never bouncy

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sacristy Teal is the only color that means "primary action" or "you are here." If two elements on a screen use full-strength teal to mean two different things, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Never-White Rule
rules.body: The base canvas is Parchment, not pure white. Pure white (Card White) is reserved for raised surfaces sitting on top of parchment — it signals elevation, not "default background."

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Prefer a heavier font-weight step over a larger font-size step when building hierarchy in dense UI (dashboards, list rows) — it holds density without shrinking touch targets or overflowing narrow columns.

rules.name: The Whisper Rule
rules.body: No shadow in this system exceeds ~10% opacity. If a shadow reads as a hard drop rather than a soft lift, it's too strong for ACTSIX.

dos: Do use Sacristy Teal for exactly one thing per screen: the primary action or the current location. Never two unrelated teal elements competing for the eye.
Do keep the base page background Parchment, reserving pure white for raised surfaces only.
Do lead hierarchy with font-weight (800/700 vs 400/500) before reaching for a larger size.
Do keep shadows under ~10% opacity — a lift, never a hard drop.
Do use the sage/sand/bronze categorical set for tags and categories that need to stay visually subordinate to teal.
donts: Don't introduce a second saturated accent color. Sage, sand, and bronze are muted categorical colors, not competing brand colors.
Don't use sharp (0-radius) corners anywhere in the product — every control has at least --radius-control.
Don't signal state (active/error/success) by color alone — pair with icon, weight, or position, per the accessibility floor in .ai/PRODUCT_GUIDE.md.
Don't let cards or panels stack multiple visible shadows — pick one elevation step per surface.
